entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that configures IP addresses and obtains IP address allocations via various mechanisms during EPS bearer establishment.

entities.name: Default EPS Bearer
entities.description: The primary bearer established for a PDN connection that enables IP connectivity and IP address configuration.

entities.name: IPv4 Address Allocation
entities.description: Procedure for allocating IPv4 addresses to the UE via DHCPv4 or NAS signaling during default EPS bearer establishment.

entities.name: IPv6 Prefix Allocation
entities.description: Procedure for allocating IPv6 prefixes to the UE via stateless address autoconfiguration or stateful DHCPv6 Prefix Delegation.

entities.name: IPv6 Parameter Configuration
entities.description: Procedure for configuring IPv6 parameters via stateless DHCPv6.

entities.name: Default Bearer Deactivation
entities.description: Procedure where the UE locally releases any allocated IPv4 address or IPv6 prefix when the default bearer of a PDN connection is deactivated.

entities.name: PDN Connection
entities.description: The connection between the UE and a Packet Data Network that includes one or more EPS bearers.

relations.description: UE performs IPv4 address allocation procedure during default EPS bearer establishment.
UE performs IPv6 prefix allocation procedure during default EPS bearer establishment.
UE performs IPv6 parameter configuration via stateless DHCPv6.
Default bearer deactivation causes local release of IP addresses for the corresponding PDN connection.
IPv4 address allocation occurs during default EPS bearer establishment.
IPv6 prefix allocation occurs during default EPS bearer establishment.
